ragdolldeaths.config.title: Ragdoll Deaths
ragdolldeaths.config.physicsRagdolls.too: Dead mobs become real physics bodies that fall, tumble and collide with blocks. Off brings back the animation-only deaths, which are lighter on weak computers.
ragdolldeaths.config.bodyLifetimeTicks.t: How long a body stays before it vanishes. Anything past 1 second is drawn only on your client after the server removes the mob.
ragdolldeaths.config.physicsQuality.tool: How much of the physics is worked out. Low is lighter on the computer, and bodies no longer pile up on each other. High is steadier in crowded piles.
ragdolldeaths.config.reflexes.tooltip: Arms thrown out in a forward fall, chin tucked in a backward one.
ragdolldeaths.config.impactSounds.toolti: The thud of a body hitting a block, a splash in water, the clatter of loose bones. Only you hear them.
ragdolldeaths.config.impactParticles.too: A puff of the block's dust on a hard landing, and drops of water on a splash.
ragdolldeaths.config.blood.tooltip: Drops of blood from where the killing blow struck, stains on the ground that fade away, blood on dead bodies, and on living mobs that are hurt. Bones, golems, slimes, blazes, breezes, shulkers, allays, vexes and mannequins never bleed, and nothing bleeds in lava. Only you see it.
ragdolldeaths.config.pushBodies.tooltip: Players and living mobs that walk into a body push it along. The body never pushes back, so moving stays exactly as in vanilla, and only you see it move.
ragdolldeaths.config.deathCameraDistance: How far the death camera stays from your body's head. It moves closer when a wall is in the way.
The death camera slowly circles your body. Off, it holds the angle it started from.
ragdolldeaths.config.playerBodyUntilResp: A player's body stays where it fell until that player respawns, instead of going after the body lifetime.
ragdolldeaths.config.deathCamera.tooltip: When you die, the view follows your own body's head and slowly circles it, so you watch yourself fall. It goes back to normal when you respawn.
ragdolldeaths.config.stuckArrows.tooltip: Arrows that hit a mob stay in its dead body, the way they show on players, until the body disappears.
ragdolldeaths.config.stuckArrowsOnLiving: With Stuck Arrows on Bodies on, living mobs show the arrows stuck in them too. Only you see them.
ragdolldeaths.config.kneesAndElbows.tool: Cuts arms and legs in two so physics bodies bend at the knee and elbow, only the way a person's do and up to 89 degrees, and crumple instead of falling stiff. Costs more per body, and limbs are no longer vanilla's single piece.
ragdolldeaths.config.enabled.tooltip: Turns the death animations on or off. When off, every mob and player dies with the normal Minecraft animation.
ragdolldeaths.config.playerRagdolls.tool: Animate players too, including yourself in third person.
ragdolldeaths.config.animationSpeed.tool: Plays every death faster or slower. 100% is the tuned speed.
ragdolldeaths.config.maxRenderDistance.t: Deaths farther from the camera than this use the vanilla death.
ragdolldeaths.config.maxActiveRagdolls.t: The most bodies at once, physics bodies included. When another physics body is needed, the oldest one vanishes; past the limit, deaths use the vanilla death.
ragdolldeaths.config.hideDeathTint.toolt: Removes the red tint from dying bodies. Normal hits still flash red.
ragdolldeaths.config.hitReactionStrength: How far the killing blow pushes the body.
ragdolldeaths.config.bounceStrength.tool: How much bodies bounce and settle when they hit the ground.
ragdolldeaths.config.limbAnimation.toolt: Animates heads, arms, legs, wings and tails. Off moves the whole body only.
ragdolldeaths.config.legKicks.tooltip: Fading kicks, twitches and paddling after a body lands.
ragdolldeaths.config.waterBehavior.toolt: What land mobs do when they die in water.
ragdolldeaths.config.lavaSink.tooltip: Bodies sink into lava and vanish early.
ragdolldeaths.config.fallImpact.tooltip: Fall-damage deaths slam flat onto the ground.
ragdolldeaths.config.throwRiders.tooltip: A rider that dies on a mob it is riding is thrown off. Off, those riders keep the vanilla death. Riders in boats and minecarts always get a body.
ragdolldeaths.config.excludedEntities.to: Entity ids that always keep the vanilla death, separated by commas. A bare name means minecraft:.
